quote:
Roman worked with us for around a year on Nothing Held Back, our membership and coaching platform built on Bubble.io. He shipped a lot in that time, but what I valued most was that we could hand him the hard, systems-level stuff and not worry about it.

He actually understands how Bubble works under the hood. When our server capacity started creeping up before a launch, he went through the database searches, workflows, and data-fetching to find where the load was really coming from and what to do about it.

That kind of skill is rare. Most people building in Bubble stay on the surface. Roman doesn't.

A few of the bigger things he took on:
- A performance audit of our live app to find the heaviest capacity drains before we scaled.
- A Netflix-style account-sharing prevention system, where he researched device fingerprinting, IP/geo signals, and session limits and weighed the tradeoffs before picking an approach.
- Geo-blocking at signup, built inside the app when infrastructure-level blocking wasn't possible, including IP country detection and a config we could change without redeploying.
- A billing reconciliation tool that parsed thousands of subscription records, cross-checked them against our database, and flagged only the real mismatches for review, with safety checks so nothing got cancelled by accident.

He also oowed whole areas of the product. Our Library, Resources, and Fast Feedback systems were his, including a full Fast Feedback redesign and an admin analytics dashboard he built from the ground up.
And he was good at tracing tricky bugs to their actual cause instead of patching symptoms.

Roman is reliable, he thinks things through, and he's genuinely strong on the architecture side. If you're building something on Bubble that needs to hold up as it grows, he's a good person to have.
